responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust expressions from AST into HIR expression nodes. It handles both simple and structured expression forms such as tuples, calls, method calls, assignments, literals, borrows, dereferences, returns, closures, ranges, paths, matches, and block-bearing expressions by delegating to specialized block, path, type, pattern, and struct-field lowerers as needed. The file is responsible for creating the correct HIR::Expr subclasses, propagating termination information for control-flow expressions, and inserting the resulting expressions and source locations into the global HIR mapping tables.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable lowering logic for expression AST nodes into concrete HIR::Expr objects, including node creation, termination tracking, and registration in mappings, whereas rust-ast-lower-expr.h only declares the expression/path lowerer classes and their entry points.
